units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	"But for the sake of the Incipias, this one will assist you on this last point. units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|log|308|0
units.english: The Incipias are a species of aliens that live to the northeast of Hai space. They originated from a gas giant, and resemble large, floating octopi. As they have not yet developed the hyperdrive, they are confined to a single system and are under the protection of the Quarg.
units.raw: log "Factions" "Incipias" `The Incipias are a species of aliens that live to the northeast of Hai space. They originated from a gas giant, and resemble large, floating octopi. As they have not yet developed the hyperdrive, they are confined to a single system and are under the protection of the Quarg.`

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|Thanks to the map, you are easily able to dock with the station. Your airlock opens and you enter an environment like nothing you've ever seen before. There are no hallways like you would see in a human space station - instead, tubes full of fog, some of which even ascend vertically, appear to be the only way of getting around. A crowd of beings gather in front of your airlock, each flashing a multitude of colors. A group of five floats in front of the crowd, and you finally get a good look at the creatures. They are large, about three meters tall, with a bulbous section at the top covered in scale-like structures. Near the base of the bulb, three large eyes are arranged in a shallow arc, below which there are eight undulating, dexterous-looking tentacles. The Incipias in the middle of the group starts pulsating in calm tones.|310|0

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	"We shall allow you to buy one, if that is all that it takes to make you a not-danger. Please excuse us. We need to talk about what this new situation-opportunity means for our species. I hope we can out-question you more another time."|325|0

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 1|	"So they are still alive. We shall give you access to our ships, so that you may enter the air-planet they have taken refuge in. Do note though that they cannot jump between system-places, not like your own ship. We hope to question you more on another future-time."|329|0
units.english: "So they are still alive. We shall give you access to our ships, so that you may enter the air-planet they have taken refuge in. Do note though that they cannot jump between system-places, not like your own ship. We hope to question you more on another future-time."
units.raw: `	"So they are still alive. We shall give you access to our ships, so that you may enter the air-planet they have taken refuge in. Do note though that they cannot jump between system-places, not like your own ship. We hope to question you more on another future-time."`
